reviews.x: I just started to stamp and i am in love with doing it! I got this BM set and it is AMAZING im surprised that some people have mixed reviews about bundle monster because they DO work and they are great designs. I'm new to stamping so i can see how i could have messed up but with PRACTICE you get the hang of it. There are a lot of other variables that could mess up the process not just the plates so i feel some more negative reviews could have been because of many other factors like drying time,
2 day shipping and it arrived in great shape. The stamps worked great!!! Some of them didn't turn out the greatest but some of them were awesome! This is a great buy for a great price!

First time stamper here... and I'm wondering where stamping plates have been all my life?? I love these. The etchings are well done and the images transfer well. My only complaint is that I spent 2 days scouring amazon to decide which set to get as my first set. I do wish this had more floral choices, but overall I am very pleased with my purchase.

reviews.t: Etched well, but I wish images were larger.
reviews.x: Amazing images that stamp very well. My only complaint and the reason for taking off a star is that some of the images are too small for longer nails. I'm not yet good enough at stamping to "stretch" the images yet, but I plan to learn.

These are the stamping plates that I use all the time. I stamp over gel nail polish with konad stamping polish, Essie polish, or Sallie Hanson insta-dri polish. When you first pull off the blue protective film, clean the plates really well with acetone. Then,  I usually paint, scrape, roll, and then clean everything off without actually rolling the first stamping on my nails. reviews.x: Some of the plates aren't etched deep enough so the stamp doesn't transfer.  I have at least 6 plates from this set that are completely useless.  Namely, #'s 611, 614, 610, 607, the top image on 618 and 616.  Basically the exact plates that I purchased this collection for and it makes me mad.  Don't waste your $.

reviews.t: Okay value, lots of useless designs
reviews.x: Images were very small and some don't hold and release enough polish to imprint a design at all. I would say one third of each plate is useless but for the money it was okay.
these stamping plates are AMAZING! i love the patterns - now i just have to master using them and getting them on perfectly :)
Packed nicely, arrived in time frame stated, product stamps nicely....great variety of designs in bundle.
Love them! Every pattern I've tried so far has been etched deep enough and they're all so cute. I've been trying regular stamping and making decals, they're very fun.

I love these stamping plates! This was my first big set of plates and is still one of my favourites. Since the designs are etched deeply enough, the images come out clean, effortlessly. There's such a great variety and such a large number of images to choose from, and they can be combined to make some beautiful nail art. I just love that one set has everything from floral to comics to geometric designs, and both big and small stamps (tiny designs and full nail designs). I ended up buying another

I'm not too happy with the consistency of etching on these plates. The designs I really wanted (mostly the tribal ones) aren't etched well and don't pick up evenly. I've used three different stampers (which will pick up images from my other brand plates) and haven't gotten a good pick up. Some images work (the small ones) and some don't (ones with broad lines or large fill areas). I use the Konad brand stamping polish, which is great, but based on my experience with these plates, I'm not sure if

Arrived completely scratched to pieces, with entire chunks missing from some of the stencils. Very disappointed, since they are great images, but most are completely unusable considering the extent of the damage.  I know a few people have left similar reviews, so it seems a bit like luck of the draw on whether you receive a fresh set or a set that has clearly been used and abused. These are nice quality bundle monster plates. Anyone who does nail art knows bundle monster is one of the better stamping plate brands these live up to that expectation. If you are just starting out please realize these do not come with a stamper or scraper so you will have to get at least the stamper (an old gift card or credit card is a better scraper than any other one I've owned). Some of the designs are too large for my nails but most fit them fine and I love the variety of this set.

reviews.t: Used these for the first time tonight the images were ...
reviews.x: Used these for the first time tonight the images were just as pictured and even came with a plastic coating to prevent scratched during shipping. Worked amazingly. One tip leave the polish to sit for a minute or so before scraping it off so it gets into all areas of the image you're wishing to stamp. Most stampers say to rub it off, but with some of the designs with smaller lines you should definitely give it a minute.

reviews.t: I love Bundle Monster stamping plates
reviews.x: I love Bundle Monster stamping plates, including these.  However, some of the designs in this set were a little too big for my nails.  I am able to use parts of some of the larger designs, but I can't use all of them unfortunately.  Still a great set, though... there are still plenty of designs to work with.  Plus, this one has dinosaurs!

Cute stamping plates. I like many of the designs in this set. Bundle Monster stamping plates have always worked for me. I gave it 4 stars because it comes in a zip top baggie instead of a case & some of the designs were not my favorite or didn't fit the theme of the set... Like the 2014 tour de France stamp.

reviews.t: Very good imprint for a crisp, clear stamp and lots of images to choose from
reviews.x: This is my first attempt at stamping...and these plates are terrific! The images are deep enough to get a good imprint. This bundle has a lot of images to choose from, so even if some aren't to my liking, I can find plenty that are.  The photo shows the stamp on my ring finger (green stamp over gold base)

reviews.t: Well made, crisp transfers, beautiful images!
reviews.x: I received this 2012 collection by Bundle Monster few weeks ago and have enjoyed using it. Love almost all plates.  The etching is crisp and transfers very well.  The size of images is bigger than their first collection from prior year, although I wish it was even slightly bigger to for my thumb.

reviews.t: Nice collection, love the large patterns
reviews.x: Nice selection of nail stamp patterns. Still getting the hang of how to apply, but that's nothing to do with this set. I particularly like the availability of large patterns that cover the whole nail, as some of the smaller items can get lost if you don't put a background color on first.

reviews.t: and get fantastic results every time
reviews.x: All of these plates are engraved consistently and with quality, and I've never had issues picking up any images.  I use mostly sinful colors and mpolishes for stamping, and a pueen and messy mansion stamper, and get fantastic results every time!

two of the plates were not picking up well. But bundle monster sent replacement plates for free then I found out it was my stamper that was not picking up well. All in all they are exactly what I expected and are just gorgeous and fun designs 😃

Love this stamper kit. I use with Konad stamping polish and the Finger Angel clear stamper and my images come out every time. I also use a plastic business card to load the image, and to me, that works much better than the firmer scrapers

This was my first real stamping set. I like that there is a nice variety that includes holiday images. Images pick up nicely with a soft stamper. A great set if you are just starting out and don't want to invest in expensive plates.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the designs and find the plates a great value, with images that stamp well and a wide variety of patterns.
Several reviewers report inconsistent etching, with some plates not etched deep enough to transfer the image properly.
Some reviewers complain that images are too small for longer nails or that a portion of designs are unusable.
A few reviewers received scratched or damaged plates, making them unusable.
Reviewers note that practice is needed to master stamping, and that the set does not include a stamper or scraper.
